# RAGU G
**Senior Backend Engineer**

[www.ragug.com](http://www.ragug.com) · [github.com/ragug](https://github.com/ragug) · [linkedin.com/in/ragug](https://linkedin.com/in/ragug) · [ragug.medium.com](https://ragug.medium.com/)
Namakkal, Tamil Nadu, India · +91 7598226670 · ragu19062002@gmail.com

---

## Summary

Backend engineer with 3+ years of experience designing, operating and scaling production systems. Applied CQRS, event-driven design, cache-aside with stampede protection, and outbox-style consistency in a mobile preventive-maintenance platform serving 5k active users at 200+ RPS. Architected a Kafka + TimescaleDB pipeline ingesting 8.5 crore (85M) writes every 5 minutes, sharded by state with Patroni-based HA, cutting storage by 80%. Cut a write API from 1300ms to 195ms and a list query from 500ms to 50ms through profiling-driven optimization. Built a RAG shopping assistant (Scrapy, Pinecone, LangChain, OpenAI) and integrated a TensorFlow image-validation model into production. Led ambiguous, platform-level work end to end: architecture, delivery, CI/CD, monitoring, documentation and mentoring.

---

## Technical Skills

* **Languages:** Python, Java, SQL; familiar with Go and Rust
* **Frameworks:** FastAPI, Flask, Django, Spring Boot, Celery, Pytest
* **Architecture:** Microservices, Domain-Driven Design, CQRS, Event-Driven Architecture, Transactional Outbox, Idempotent APIs, Circuit Breaker, API Versioning, Cache-Aside
* **Databases:** PostgreSQL (partitioning, sharding, replication, Patroni HA, PgBouncer, partial indexes, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, materialized views), TimescaleDB, MongoDB, Redis (caching, distributed locks, Pub/Sub)
* **Messaging & Data:** Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery, Airflow, Polars, Pandas
* **AI / LLM:** RAG, LangChain, Pinecone, OpenAI API, embeddings, TensorFlow model training and serving
* **Cloud & Infra:** AWS, GCP, S3/MinIO, serverless, Docker Swarm/Compose, Kubernetes (Selenium Grid), Nginx (load balancing, endpoint allow-listing), Linux (RHEL), air-gapped environments
* **CI/CD & DevOps:** GitLab CI/CD, Makefile-driven build/deploy automation, automated rollback, unit + integration test gates
* **Observability:** ELK, Elastic APM, Grafana, Uptime Kuma, n8n alerting workflows
* **AI-Augmented Development:** GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, AI in CI/CD

---

## Professional Experience

**Senior Python Developer** | SMTlabs (Vendor: Vodafone Idea) | *Mar 2025 – Sep 2026*
*Preventive Maintenance System (PMS): mobile-first platform replacing paper checklists for tower maintenance*
* Designed the system with **Domain-Driven Design** (Scheduling, Checklist Submission, Approval as bounded contexts); engineers submit checklists with photo proof, **geofencing** verifies presence, managers approve on a live dashboard. Presented the architecture to client stakeholders onsite in Pune.
* Applied **CQRS** to the 6-month reports module, where multi-table joins made reads too slow: writes go to the transactional model, an hourly job refreshes **materialized views**, and all report reads hit only the views (1-hour staleness accepted by the business). Report queries dropped from **10-15 s to 20-40 ms**.
* Built **event-driven** pipelines: image uploads are queued in **RabbitMQ** and processed asynchronously by a **TensorFlow** validation worker; **Redis Pub/Sub + SSE** deliver real-time notifications; **Celery** handles file exports; task creation is **idempotent**. Queue success rate held at ~99%.
* Trained the image model iteratively (1k labeled images, then 2k, then 10k); managers get a per-task validity report (e.g., 400/500 valid).
* **Performance:** write API 1300ms → 195ms (upserts, bulk creates, S3 work offloaded to Celery); list-task query 500ms → 50ms (EXPLAIN ANALYZE, partial indexes, caching, CTEs); the system sustains **200+ RPS at 5ms P95** at peak for **5k active users**.
* **Caching:** cache-aside with a Redis distributed lock to prevent cache stampede; **98.5% hit ratio**.
* **Consistency:** outbox-style deferred S3/MinIO cleanup (deletions recorded in the DB, removed by an off-peak job) so storage outages never break user requests.
* **Reliability:** multi-server Docker Swarm deployment with instant rollback; Nginx load balancer with circuit-breaking (a server is removed from rotation after 30+ 5xx responses per minute); **PgBouncer** to prevent Postgres connection exhaustion; API versioning so old mobile app versions keep working; Nginx endpoint allow-list acting as a lightweight API gateway.
* **Observability & incident response:** ELK + Elastic APM for tracing; alerts when 5xx exceed 5 per day, plus a daily 5xx report; Grafana dashboards for uptime, CPU, RAM, containers, p90/p95/p99 latency and task metrics; n8n + custom email API for alert routing.
* **Uptime:** maintained **99% uptime** using multi-server deployment, health-based routing and alerting.
* **Quality:** unit + integration tests gate every merge in CI. Integrated **AI-assisted PR review into CI/CD**: it summarizes each change and checks it against the team's coding standards and review checklist, replacing repetitive manual checklist reviews, saving reviewer time and reducing human error.
* **Data engineering:** cut an inventory-sync job from **1 day to 5 minutes** by moving logic from Python loops to in-database SQL with temp tables, switching Pandas to **Polars**, and orchestrating all DAGs with **Airflow**.

*Zabbix-Based Incident & Monitoring Platform (system design)*
* Architected a nationwide time-series pipeline ingesting **8.5 crore writes every 5 minutes** via **Kafka (4 topics)** into **TimescaleDB**, with **state-based sharding into 4 databases**, **2 read replicas each**, **Patroni HA**, and compression, cutting storage by **80%**. Live in production.

*Platform & Data Engineering*
* Built an **air-gapped internal ecosystem** used by other teams: private PyPI, npm and Docker registries, OpenProject, Uptime Kuma, pgBackRest Web for backups, and an LDAP auth API (initially in Go, migrated to Python for maintainability) used by other projects to authenticate users. Deployed **Outline** for team documentation.
* Modernized a legacy project that ran on bare servers with `nohup` into Docker, Docker Swarm, CI/CD, S3 storage, documentation and task tracking.
* Designed shared business logic and API contracts used across frontend and backend teams.
* Own code quality: code reviews, standards, mentoring on distributed-systems practices.

**Python Developer** | Relu Consultancy | *Jun 2023 – Mar 2025*
* **Technical lead** for a distributed team of **20 developers** building scrapers; set technical direction and code standards, and reviewed all code and solutions before release.
* Drove delivery of **Rapid API**, Relu's commercial web-scraping API product covering multiple platforms (YouTube, LinkedIn, India Post, Amazon and more): broke work into ClickUp tasks (assigned by the manager based on developer availability) and owned solution design, code review, optimization and deployment.
* Designed the serverless backend on **AWS and GCP**, with CI/CD that auto-provisions instances and autoscales under load.
* Built a production **RAG shopping assistant**: scraped 200+ Shopify stores with Scrapy, indexed embeddings in Pinecone, orchestrated retrieval + generation with LangChain and OpenAI for natural-language product search.
* Scaled scraping from 20 → 60 workers to a **Kubernetes-orchestrated Selenium Grid** (300+ concurrent browsers across 5 servers, proxy rotation).
* Wrote Pytest unit and integration suites for release stability.

**Java Software Developer Intern** | Cognizant | *Feb 2023 – Jun 2023*
* Built backend APIs with Spring Boot; contributed to Agile ceremonies, bug resolution and technical documentation.

---

## Projects
* **Ragu Tools:** offline-first, privacy-focused developer utilities (Base64, password generator) running entirely in-browser. [github.com/Ragug/ragu-tools](https://github.com/Ragug/ragu-tools)
* **Expense Tracker (Go):** REST expense-tracking service. [github.com/Ragug/expense-tracker-go](https://github.com/Ragug/expense-tracker-go)
* **Elective Subject Picker:** Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB elective-allocation system. [github.com/Ragug/ElectiveSubjectPicker](https://github.com/Ragug/ElectiveSubjectPicker)

## Technical Writing
* [Real-Time Notifications with FastAPI, Redis and Postgres](https://ragug.medium.com/real-time-notifications-with-fastapi-redis-and-postgres-f0a0ca2439c2)
* [Why You Should Dump JWT for PASETO v4, and How to Use v4.public / v4.local](https://ragug.medium.com/why-you-should-dump-jwt-for-paseto-v4-and-how-to-use-v4-public-v4-local-f6e1b1e9c538)

## Achievements & Open Source
* **Winner, KEC Hackathon 2023:** led a team to first place with an AI face-recognition attendance system.
* **curl_cffi:** improved `Response` repr to show HTTP status codes. **pyseto:** refactored registered-claims validation helpers.

## Education
* **B.E. Electrical and Electronics Engineering**, Kongu Engineering College | 2020 – 2023
* **Diploma, Electrical and Electronics Engineering**, Muthayammal Polytechnic College | 2017 – 2020

# RAGU G

**Senior Backend Engineer | LLM & Generative AI Systems**

[www.ragug.com](http://www.ragug.com) · [github.com/ragug](https://github.com/ragug) · [+91 7598226670](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=917598226670&text=Hi%20Ragu)
Namakkal, Tamil Nadu, India · [linkedin.com/in/ragug](https://linkedin.com/in/ragug) · [ragu19062002@gmail.com](mailto:ragu19062002@gmail.com) · [ragug.medium.com](https://ragug.medium.com/)

---

## Summary

Backend engineer with 3+ years of experience building **production LLM-powered and Generative AI applications** alongside high-throughput distributed systems. Built and shipped a **production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) shopping assistant** — scraping data from 200+ sources, indexing embeddings in a **Pinecone vector database**, and orchestrating retrieval + generation with the **OpenAI API via LangChain** — to power natural-language (semantic) product search. Designed a Kafka-fed, TimescaleDB-backed **ETL/data pipeline** ingesting 8.5 crore writes every 5 minutes with state-based partitioning and read replicas, cutting storage costs by 80%. Built a Domain-Driven Design mobile preventive-maintenance platform integrating a **TensorFlow** model for automated image validation, with geofencing and manager approval workflows, presented directly to clients onsite. Led a 20-developer team building serverless scraping infrastructure across AWS and GCP with automated CI/CD provisioning. Comfortable owning ambiguous, platform-level problems end to end — from **prompt engineering** and AI orchestration workflow design to production rollout, monitoring, and incident response.

---

## Technical Skills

* **LLM & Generative AI:** LLM Integration (OpenAI API), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Pipelines, Vector Databases (Pinecone), Semantic Search, Embeddings, Prompt Engineering, AI Orchestration Workflows, LangChain, Agentic Workflow Design, AI-Augmented CI/CD Automation, AI-Assisted Development (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code)
* **Languages:** Python, Java, SQL, Rust, Go-Lang, JavaScript
* **Backend Frameworks:** FastAPI, Flask, Django, Spring Boot, Pytest
* **Distributed Systems & Architecture:** Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Concurrent Programming, Design Patterns, Service Decomposition
* **Databases:** PostgreSQL (partitioning, replication, query optimization), TimescaleDB (time-series, compression), MongoDB, Redis (Pub/Sub, caching)
* **Messaging & Streaming:** Apache Kafka (high-volume ingestion pipelines), Celery, Apache Airflow
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:** AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), serverless architectures, Docker (Swarm, Compose), Kubernetes (Selenium Grid orchestration at scale), Linux (RHEL)
* **CI/CD & DevOps:** GitLab CI/CD, auto-provisioning & autoscaling pipelines, Git, GitHub
* **Observability:** ELK Stack, Grafana, Log Analysis, Incident Troubleshooting, AI Evaluation & Monitoring
* **Web/API:** REST APIs, JSON, HTML, CSS

---

## Professional Experience

**Senior Python Developer** | SMTlabs (Vendor: Vodafone Idea) | *March 2025 – Present*

*Project: Preventive Maintenance System (PMS)*
* Designed and built, using **Domain-Driven Design (DDD)**, a mobile-first preventive maintenance platform replacing a paper checklist process for tower equipment maintenance — modeling Maintenance Scheduling, Checklist Submission, and Approval as distinct bounded contexts.
* Built the backend APIs powering the mobile app: engineers submit checklists with photo proof, **geofencing verifies on-site presence**, and managers get a **live dashboard** to review and approve submissions.
* Integrated a **TensorFlow** computer-vision model to automatically validate uploaded photos, reducing manual review effort and human error in the approval process.
* Own end-to-end monitoring for the system using **ELK Stack** and **Grafana**, and led production troubleshooting and incident resolution.
* Designed and led implementation of scalable microservices using **FastAPI** and **PostgreSQL**, sustaining **195+ RPS** at a **5ms P95 latency**.
* Integrated an **AI-powered code automation framework** into CI/CD pipelines, reducing manual engineering bottlenecks by **40%**.
* Traveled onsite to **Pune** for face-to-face client meetings to gather requirements and walk stakeholders through system architecture and logic.

*Project: Zabbix-Based Incident & Monitoring Platform*
* Architected a large-scale time-series **data pipeline** for a nationwide tower network, ingesting **8.5 crore (85M) writes every 5 minutes** via **Kafka** into **TimescaleDB**.
* Designed a **4-way state-based database partitioning scheme** with **2 read replicas per partition**, combined with data compression — reduced production storage footprint by **80%**, now running live in production.
* Led the research and architecture effort end-to-end, guiding the team through migration and validating scalability and high-availability of the new design.

*Across both projects:* Own code quality across the backend team — conduct comprehensive code reviews, enforce maintainability standards, and mentor engineers on distributed-systems best practices.

**Python Developer** | Relu Consultancy | *June 2023 – March 2025*

* Led a distributed team of **20 developers**, each owning scraper development for a specific target website; set technical direction and code standards across the group.
* Designed and deployed the platform's serverless backend across **AWS and GCP**, building **CI/CD pipelines that auto-provision new serverless instances and autoscale under load**.
* Built a production **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) shopping assistant**: scraped product data from **200+ Shopify stores** using **Scrapy**, generated and indexed **embeddings in a Pinecone vector database**, and orchestrated retrieval + generation with **OpenAI** via **LangChain** — enabling **LLM-powered semantic / natural-language product search** (e.g., "red dress") for end users.
* Designed the **prompt engineering** and retrieval strategy for the RAG pipeline, tuning chunking, top-k retrieval, and context assembly to improve answer relevance and reduce hallucination in generated responses.
* Evolved the scraping engine from a custom concurrency model (20 → 60 workers) to a **Kubernetes-orchestrated Selenium Grid**, scaling to **300+ concurrent browser instances across 5 servers with proxy rotation**.
* Authored automated test suites and integration tests using **Pytest** to ensure release stability.

**Java Software Developer Intern** | Cognizant | *February 2023 – June 2023*

* Built enterprise-grade backend APIs using **Java Spring Boot**, following standard SDLC methodology.
* Participated in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, standups) and contributed to requirements analysis and bug resolution.
* Authored internal technical documentation for application logic and new system components.

---

## Projects

**Ragu Tools** — *Offline-First Developer Utility Suite* | [github.com/Ragug/ragu-tools](https://github.com/Ragug/ragu-tools)
Privacy-first, client-side suite of developer utilities (Base64 encode/decode, cryptographic password generation, and more) that runs entirely in-browser with zero network calls, zero tracking, and zero server logging. Built for instant, offline-capable performance with a high-contrast dark/light UI across desktop and mobile.

**Expense Tracker (Go)** | [github.com/Ragug/expense-tracker-go](https://github.com/Ragug/expense-tracker-go)
Lightweight expense-tracking service built in Go, demonstrating backend fundamentals outside the primary Python/Java stack — REST-style data handling and clean service structuring.

**Elective Subject Picker** | [github.com/Ragug/ElectiveSubjectPicker](https://github.com/Ragug/ElectiveSubjectPicker)
Full-stack academic system built with **Java, Spring Boot, and MongoDB** to solve a real-world elective allocation problem faced by students on campus — covering data modeling, backend APIs, and application logic end to end.

---

## Achievements

**🏆 Winner — KEC Hackathon 2023 (Software Edition)**
Led a team to first place (₹4,500 prize) in a 30-hour hackathon, building a portable face-recognition-based attendance system using AI and computer vision. Delivered a user-friendly, reliable, and secure solution designed for real-world deployment across educational and enterprise settings.

---
